        print(f'  TABLE {i+1}: STILL HAS CAPTION BELOW (caption at {caption_pos}, tabular ends at {tabular_end})')

        print(f'  TABLE {i+1}: OK (caption at {caption_pos}, tabular ends at {tabular_end})')

        print(f'  TABLE {i+1}: no caption or no tabular found')
"; done
